content: The clitoral glans, also known as the glans clitoridis, is the external, visible part of the clitoris. It is covered by the clitoral hood, a protective fold of skin that is also external and connected to the labia minora. The clitoral glans is further connected to the frenulum clitoridis, a structure that is similarly attached to the labia minora. Internally, the clitoral glans is linked to the clitoral body, which extends beneath the surface.
